from tools import search_hotels, search_attractions, filter_attractions, search_nearest, sort_results, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached attraction results
attractions_result = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Search for hotels in Raleigh with the specified criteria
hotels_result = search_hotels(
    city="Raleigh",
    checkin_date=["2025-08-03"],
    checkout_date=["2025-08-04"],
    num_people=4,
    neighborhood=["Downtown Raleigh"],
    budget=45
)

# Save hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="hotels", value=hotels_result)

# Search for cultural attractions in Raleigh
attractions_search = search_attractions(
    city="Raleigh",
    type=["Cultural"]
)

# Save attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions_search)

# Find the nearest attractions to the hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=hotels_result,
    attractions=attractions_search,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

# Save nearest attractions to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)

# Sort attractions by rating
sorted_attractions = sort_results(
    results=nearest_attractions,
    column="rating_attractions",
    ascending=True
)

# Save sorted attractions to cache
save_to_cache(key="sorted_attractions", value=sorted_attractions)
